modules.text: Retroactive record, written 2026-09-15 from PR #106 merged at f558d0e8fc916eef494fffcef09cfe2ac5582b8e.

dependency-direction.text: Identity flows from the deployment command into the manifest; the manifest flows into every runner; runners keep their existing connected transaction builders and authorization checks. Docs describe the commands; they do not define deployment identity.

promotion.text: One new library module owned by deployment and the attached runners. No shared extraction beyond it; no changes to Lean, validators, workflow or CI gates.
